test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Among six persons. P, Q, R, S, T and U, each one has a different weight. The weight of Q is more than only two other persons. The weight of P is more than U’s weight. The weight of S is more than Q’s weight. The weight of R is less than the weight of T. The weight of Q is more than the weight of T. U has the second highest weight among all the six persons. Who has the third highest weight among all six persons?
solution:
Given: Six persons P, Q, R, S, T, and U each have a different weight.

1) The weight of Q is more than only two other persons.

⇒ Q > _ > _

2) The weight of P is more than U’s weight.

P > U

3) The weight of S is more than Q’s weight.

S > Q

4) The weight of R is less than the weight of T.

T > R

5) T
